name: TimescaleDB
description: PostgreSQL extension for high-performance time-series. v2.27 brings unlogged hypertables, trigger-free continuous aggregates, and vectorized aggregation for ~3.5x faster columnstore queries.
note: UPDATE: Postgres-native time-series; drop-in for existing SQL workflows.

name: libmodbus
description: The de-facto open-source C library for Modbus RTU (RS-232/485) and Modbus TCP communication.
note: The standard, battle-tested Modbus RTU library — directly serves our RS-485 sensor bus on the gateway.

name: Arduino-ESP32
description: Arduino core for the ESP32 family of SoCs. Stable 3.3.8 tracks ESP-IDF 5.x; a 4.0.0-alpha1 building on ESP-IDF 6 landed 2026-05-27.
note: Drop-in Arduino layer over ESP-IDF; great for rapid prototyping.

name: Mender
description: End-to-end OTA update manager for embedded Linux with dual A/B partitioning and automatic rollback on failed boot.
note: Atomic A/B OTA with rollback for the RPi gateway fleet — far safer than custom OTA at 1000 devices.

name: RadioLib
description: Universal wireless comms library for embedded devices with first-class SX126x/LLCC68 LoRa and a full LoRaWAN 1.1 stack. 7.7.1 fixes an OOB read/leak in LoRaWAN downlink parsing.
note: UPDATE: Best-in-class LoRa radio lib; directly drives Endo's transceivers.

name: mochi-mqtt (server)
description: Fully compliant, embeddable high-performance Go MQTT v5 broker for IoT; usable standalone or as a library. Performance comparable to Mosquitto/EMQX.
note: Embed an MQTT v5 broker directly inside our Go API — removes a separate broker dependency on the cloud side.

name: pymodbus
description: Full Modbus protocol implementation in Python with client, server, and simulator, sync and async APIs, over serial (RS-485) and TCP. 3.13.0 continues the 3.x line for Python >=3.10.
note: The standard Python Modbus stack; sync+async over serial and TCP.

name: react-native-ble-plx
description: The de-facto React Native BLE library. 3.5.x makes BleManager a reusable singleton and converts core calls to promises for proper error reporting; documented for Android 14.
note: Standard RN BLE library; core for in-app device provisioning.

name: Aider
description: Strongest all-around open-source CLI coding agent in 2026: multi-file editing, git integration, works with any LLM.
note: Model-agnostic coding agent fits our multi-model (Kimi/Claude/Gemini) workflow alongside the Pi Coding Agent.

name: ChirpStack
description: Open-source LoRaWAN Network Server. v4.18.0 hardens the admin password hashing (1000 iterations) and continues FUOTA and multi-region work.
note: UPDATE: De-facto open LoRaWAN network server for private deployments.

name: ESP-IDF
description: Espressif's official IoT development framework for the ESP32 family; v6.0 is a major release with a new toolchain, refreshed component manager, and ESP-IDF 6 peripheral APIs.
note: Core ESP32 SDK; v6 is a major step but the essential firmware base.

name: Edge Impulse (EON Compiler)
description: Web MLOps platform for TinyML; EON Compiler cuts NN RAM 25-55% and flash up to 35% for microcontrollers.
note: Fastest path to on-device sensor inference on ESP32; EON compiler squeezes models into our RAM/flash budget.

name: ShellHub
description: Centralized SSH and remote access for edge and cloud Linux devices. 2026 brings a from-scratch React/TS UI and a PostgreSQL Community-Edition store (0.25.0-rc in progress).
note: Single pane of glass SSH/fleet access for edge Raspberry Pi devices.

name: Victory Native (XL)
description: From-scratch React Native charting library using Skia for GPU-accelerated rendering, Reanimated for UI-thread animation, and Gesture Handler for native touch.
note: UPDATE: GPU-accelerated, gesture-rich charts for the mobile dashboard.

name: balena / openBalena
description: Container-based platform to build, deploy and manage fleets of Linux IoT devices; openBalena is the self-hosted OSS core.
note: Complete container-based fleet mgmt; powerful, but the container model is a shift from our current Pi setup.

name: Agno
description: Lightweight, high-performance Python framework for building multi-agent systems with memory, knowledge, and tools, focused on composability and minimal abstractions.
note: Minimal, fast framework to stand up internal agents for a small team.

name: EMQX
description: Highly scalable distributed MQTT broker. v6.2 adds native A2A agent discovery over MQTT, subscription-level filtering, dynamic keepalive, and new time-series integrations.
note: UPDATE: Scalable MQTT broker; upgrade path once Mosquitto is outgrown.

name: ESPHome
description: Declarative YAML-to-firmware system for ESP32/ESP8266 with a huge component library.
note: Great for quick sensor-node prototypes but bypasses our custom LoRa firmware/OTA stack.

name: Hard Potato
description: Python library to control commercial potentiostats and automate electrochemical experiments (CV, SWV, etc.).
note: Automate potentiostat experiment runs in Python — speeds up Tier-5 electrode characterization.

name: NanoMQ
description: Ultra-lightweight, blazing-fast MQTT broker/bus for IoT edge. 0.24.14 adds an offline message cache, NNG pub/sub bridging, richer REST querying, and resolves several high-severity CVEs.
note: UPDATE: Ultra-light edge MQTT broker for Pi gateways; patch promptly for CVEs.

name: QuestDB
description: Low-latency open-source time-series database on open formats. 9.x adds window joins, PIVOT, TICK interval DSL, AI-assisted console, and fast Parquet queries.
note: UPDATE: Blazing ingest and analytics; strong purpose-built TSDB contender.

name: TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers
description: Google's dominant TinyML runtime for quantized models on Cortex-M, ESP32 and similar MCUs.
note: The established microcontroller ML runtime with ESP32 support; lower-level/more effort than Edge Impulse.

name: mbusd
description: Open-source Modbus TCP to Modbus RTU (RS-232/485) gateway daemon.
note: Bridge RS-485 sensors to Modbus TCP on the RPi — handy for exposing the wired bus to networked services.

name: pybaselines
description: Python library of algorithms for baseline correction of 1-D and 2-D data (polynomial, Whittaker, morphological, spline, classification). Directly useful for de-trending SWV/voltammetry signals.
note: Comprehensive baseline-correction toolkit for voltammetric peaks.

name: HailoRT
description: Hailo's runtime library and tooling for the Hailo-8/8L/10H NPUs, with Python bindings, a REST API mode, and GStreamer plugins. Powers the Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ family.
note: Runtime for Hailo NPUs on Pi 5 edge boxes; compiler stays proprietary.

name: OpenHands
description: Open-source platform for autonomous software-engineering agents that write code, run tests, browse repos, and operate a real dev environment.
note: Self-hostable coding agent for offloading routine embedded/backend chores.

name: RedoxPySolid
description: Python package for data analysis and modeling of variable-frequency square-wave voltammetry (SWV).
note: Purpose-built SWV analysis — directly applicable to our Tier-5 electrochemical SOC sensor R&D.

name: react-native-ble-manager
description: Most popular RN BLE module (scan, connect, discover services/characteristics, exchange data).
note: Useful for on-site device commissioning over BLE; not core to our LoRa field comms.

name: LangGraph
description: Stateful graph runtime on LangChain; the most mature framework for long-running, stateful agents.
note: Mature stateful agent runtime if we build custom orchestration; overlaps with the existing Pi Coding Agent setup.
